title: How Notice Changes the Nights Retained on a Resort Lodging Stay
content:
How many of the nights given up on a Resort Lodging stay are retained turns on the notice the household gave, read from the requests to change the dates of the stay standing on the reservation and counted in calendar days against the departure date the reservation carries. The early departure notice period is 7 calendar days.

Where a request to change the dates of the stay stands accepted at the desk and was raised more than 7 calendar days before the departure date on the reservation, no night is retained.

Where a request to change the dates of the stay stands accepted at the desk and was raised within those 7 calendar days of the departure date, the nights retained are the nights given up less the unit type's late cancellation nights, and never fewer than none, the notice earning the household that allowance.

Where no request to change the dates of the stay stands accepted at the desk, every night given up is retained.

| What the date-change requests on the reservation show | The nights retained |
| --- | --- |
| A request standing accepted, raised more than 7 calendar days before the departure date | none |
| A request standing accepted, raised within 7 calendar days of the departure date | the nights given up, less the unit type's late cancellation nights, and never fewer than none |
| No request standing accepted | every night given up |

### The boundary and the floor (hypothetical stays)

On a stay with 4 nights given up, a request standing accepted raised 8 calendar days before the departure date was raised more than 7 days before it, and no night is retained.

On the same stay, a request standing accepted raised exactly 7 calendar days before the departure date was raised within the period, so the nights retained are the 4 given up less the unit type's late cancellation nights; where those number 2, the nights retained are 2.

On a stay with 1 night given up, a request standing accepted raised within the period would give the 1 night less the unit type's late cancellation nights; where those number 3, the count would fall below none, so the nights retained are none.

Where the reservation carries no request to change the dates of the stay standing accepted at the desk, all 4 nights given up are retained.
